_test.setup:
d="${HOME}/pw/tests/design-explorer/study"; for j in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do mkdir -p "$d/case_$j"; awk -v j=$j 'BEGIN {printf "%g max_camber
%g camber_position
%g thickness
%g angle_of_attack
", 0.01*(j-1), 0.3+0.05*(j-1), 0.08+0.02*(j-1), 2*j}' > "$d/case_$j/params.in"; if [ $j -lt 6 ]; then awk -v j=$j 'BEGIN {printf "%g drag_coefficient
%g neg_lift_coefficient
", 0.01+0.002*j, -(0.2+0.1*j)}' > "$d/case_$j/results.out"; else echo 1 > "$d/case_$j/exit_code"; fi; done
